## What changes and why?

Describe the user-visible result and link the related issue (for example, `Fixes #123`).

## Validation

- Commands/checks run:
- Results:
- Real Quest model / OS tested, or explicitly not tested:
- Screenshots for visible UI changes (demo data only):

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and preserves existing credentials and placements.
- [ ] No signing keys, HA credentials, private server details, or personal room captures are included.
- [ ] App-provided EN/VI strings are aligned, or no strings changed.
- [ ] Shared behavior works for both distributions; Store entitlement checks remain intact.
- [ ] Relevant tests and dependency notices were updated, or no update is needed.
